title: Management of Registries: Supplementary Exam, August 2018
instructions: ANSWER ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A, AND ANY OTHER TWO FROM SECTION B

parts.text: Explain five information dissemination functions performed by registry officers in a registry.
Explain five reasons for evaluating information resources in a registry.
Describe five problems encountered during evaluation of information services and systems in most registries in Kenya.
Discuss five factors you would consider in choosing a file classification system.
Discuss five factors you should consider when selecting a media format for library information resources.
Management of registries involves the application of business management principles. Discuss five principles of management which are applicable to a university registry administration.
Discuss the merits of adopting standards in records management within an organization. Standards:
Explain five aspects to consider when planning for evaluation of information resources and sources.
Discuss five factors to consider when choosing a filing system.
